# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**Best overall: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-$150)**
- What Hi-Fi's top pick. It is IP68, has 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), 40 W of power, and can charge your phone. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) listed it at $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon.
- Best Products also picked it as best overall, on sale at $150 (normally $200). [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- Buy: use the Walmart, Amazon and Best Buy price links on the [What Hi-Fi page](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart). I only have that page, not direct store links.

**Best for sand and salt water: soundcore Boom 3i ($129.99, or $104 with code AFSC20)**
- It is IP68, floats upright, is saltwater-resistant, and has 16 hours of battery. It weighs 780 g and has a detachable strap.
- One drawback is that it can't charge your phone.
- Buy: [soundcore Boom 3i](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-3i). The code price was last checked on 2026-10-22, so confirm it at checkout. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speaker-for-pool-or-beach-2026-reviews-ip67-battery-so)

**Best budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 (about $65)**
- It is IP67, floats, and has 360-degree sound. It's small and gets 14 hours of battery, but it's less loud and bassy than bigger speakers. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- Buy: [see Amazon, Walmart and Lowe's prices](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/).

**Best for tossing in a bag: JBL Grip (about $100)**
- Good Housekeeping's top pick. It is IP68, the size of a soda can, and under a pound, with 12 hours of battery. The mesh body can collect dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- Buy: [see Amazon, Walmart and Macy's links](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/).

**Best for a big party**
- **JBL Boombox 4:** RTINGS' best waterproof speaker. It floats, handles long immersion, and has over 40 hours of battery, but it's large and pricey. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **soundcore Boom 2 Plus ($249.99, or $200 with AFSC20):** 100 W, IPX7, floats, 20 hours. It weighs 3.8 kg, so it suits a beach base camp or boat better than a long walk. Buy: [Boom 2 Plus](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speaker-for-pool-or-beach-2026-reviews-ip67-battery-so)

## My pick
For most people I'd get the **JBL Charge 6**, which has the best mix of sound, battery and durability. If you'll mostly be on sand and in salt water, the **Boom 3i** is the safer choice.

## Care tips
- **IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine.** RTINGS recommends rinsing the speaker with fresh water after use. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- Close the charging-port flap before it gets wet, and dry the speaker fully before charging. [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/)
- The Dealectric links are affiliate links. Prices and codes change, so check the final price at checkout.
